info.title: Mailchimp Marketing (Independent Publisher)
info.description: Comprehensive Mailchimp Marketing API connector for audience management, campaign creation, engagement tracking, and automation workflows. Provides 40+ operations including detailed reporting on opens, clicks, and unsubscribes.

get.description: Retrieves all audiences (lists) in the Mailchimp account. Use count and offset for pagination.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of records to return (max 1000)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip for pagination

post.description: Creates a new audience (list). Note: Most accounts use one audience with tags for segmentation.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Audience details

get.description: Retrieves details and stats for a specific audience by ID

parameters.name: list_id
parameters.description: The unique ID for the audience

get.description: Retrieves members (subscribers) of a specific audience. Use count/offset for pagination (max 1000 per request).

parameters.name: list_id
parameters.description: The unique ID for the audience

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of records to return (max 1000)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by subscription status

parameters.name: since_last_changed
parameters.description: Filter by last changed date (ISO 8601 format)

post.description: Adds a new member to an audience. Use UpsertListMember instead if the member might already exist.

parameters.name: list_id
parameters.description: The unique ID for the audience

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Member details

parameters.name: list_id
parameters.description: The unique ID for the audience

parameters.name: subscriber_hash
